title: Crisp Realm (base)
description: A vanilla-based enhancement resourcepack that redesigns the items, the GUI, and some models.
body:
Esteemed peers,receive my gracious greetings.

This is a Minecraft texture pack I have created. I hope you enjoy it.

Here is [a promotional video uploaded on Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1EmudzcEjM/?spm_id_from=333.1387.homepage.video_card.click).

Still under continuous update.

As for the blocks section and so on, it will be released as a separate texture pack. Please stay tuned for further updates.
